title: For anxiety and sorrow
ar: اللّهُـمَّ إِنِّي أَعْوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الهَـمِّ وَ الْحُـزْنِ، والعًجْـزِ والكَسَلِ والبُخْـلِ والجُـبْنِ، وضَلْـعِ الـدَّيْنِ وغَلَبَـةِ الرِّجال
tr: Allāhumma 'innī 'a`ūdhu bika mina 'l-ḥammi wa 'l-ḥuzn, wa 'l-`ajzi wa 'l-kasal, wa 'l-bukhli wa 'l-jubn, wa ḍala`id-dayn, wa ghalabatir-rijāl.
en: O Allah, I seek refuge in you from grief and sadness, from weakness and from laziness, from miserliness and from cowardice, from being overcome by debt and overpowered by men (i.e. others).

title: When you feel you cannot cope
ref: Abu Dawud 4/324, Ahmad 5/42. Al-Albani graded it as good in Sahih Abu Dawud 3/959.
ar: اللّهُـمَّ رَحْمَتَـكَ أَرْجـو فَلا تَكِلـني إِلى نَفْـسي طَـرْفَةَ عَـيْن، وَأَصْلِـحْ لي شَأْنـي كُلَّـه لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أنْـت
tr: Allāhumma raḥmataka arjū falā takilnī ilā nafsī ṭarfata `ayn, wa aṣliḥ lī sha'nī kullah, lā ilāha illā ant.
en: O Allah, I hope for Your mercy. Do not leave me to myself even for the blinking of an eye (i.e. a moment). Correct all of my affairs for me. There is none worthy of worship but You.

title: The supplication of Yunus
ref: At-Tirmidhi 5/529. Al-Hakim declared it authentic and Ath-Thahabi agreed with him 1/505. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/168.
ar: لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا أنْـت سُـبْحانَكَ إِنِّي كُنْـتُ مِنَ الظّـالِميـن
tr: Lā ilāha illā anta subḥānaka innī kuntu minaẓ-ẓālimīn
en: There is none worthy of worship but You, glory is to You. Surely, I was among the wrongdoers.

title: When anxious about something specific
ref: Abu Dawud 4/326, Ibn Majah 2/1228. See also Al-Albani, Sahih Ibn Majah 2/305.
ar: اللّهُـمَّ إِنَّـي أَسْـأَلُـكَ خَيْـرَها، وَأَعـوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَـرِّها
tr: Allāhumma innī as'aluka khayrahā, wa a`ūdhu bika min sharrihā.
en: O Allah, I ask You for the good of it, and seek refuge in You against its evil.
note: Reported for a wind storm; the wording is general and is used for anything one is uneasy about.

title: For one in distress
ar: لَا إلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ الْعَظـيمُ الْحَلِـيمْ، لَا إِلَهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ رَبُّ العَـرْشِ العَظِيـمِ، لَا إِلَـهَ إِلَّا اللَّهْ رَبُّ السَّمَـوّاتِ ورّبُّ الأَرْضِ ورَبُّ العَرْشِ الكَـريم
tr: Lā ilāha illallāh al-`Aẓīmul-Ḥalīm, lā ilāha illallāh Rabbu 'l-`Arshi 'l-'Aẓīm, lā ilāha illallāh Rabbus-samāwāti wa Rabbu 'l-arḍ wa Rabbu 'l-`Arshi 'l-Karīm.
en: There is none worthy of worship but Allah, the Mighty, the Forbearing. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the Magnificent Throne. There is none worthy of worship but Allah, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, and Lord of the Noble Throne.

title: Allah, Allah is my Lord
ref: Abu Dawud 2/87. See also Al-Albani, Sahih Ibn Majah 2/335.
ar: اللهُ اللهُ رَبِّي لا أُشْـرِكُ بِهِ شَيْـئاً
tr: Allāh, Allāhu Rabbī lā ushriku bihi shay'a
en: Allah, Allah is my Lord. I do not associate anything with Him.

title: When something goes wrong
ar: قَدَّرَ اللهُ وَما شـاءَ فَعَـل
tr: Qaddarallāhu wa mā shā'a fa`al.
en: It is the Decree of Allah and He does whatever He wills.
note: Said instead of "if only I had done such and such" — the Prophet ﷺ warned that "if" opens the work of the Devil.

title: For settling a debt
ref: At-Tirmidhi 5/560. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/180.
ar: اللّهُـمَّ اكْفِـني بِحَلالِـكَ عَنْ حَـرامِـك، وَأَغْنِـني بِفَضْـلِكَ عَمَّـنْ سِـواك
tr: Allāhummak-finī biḥalālika `an ḥarāmik, wa 'aghninī bi faḍlika `amman siwāk.
en: O Allah, suffice me with what You have allowed instead of what You have forbidden, and make me independent of all others besides You.

title: Refuge from debt and being overpowered
ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنَ الْهَمِّ وَالْحَزَنِ، وَالْعَجْزِ وَالْكَسَلِ، وَالْبُخْلِ وَالْجُبْنِ، وَضَلَعِ الدَّيْنِ وَغَلَبَةِ الرِّجَالِ
tr: Allāhumma innī a`ūdhu bika mina 'l-ḥammi wa 'l-ḥazan, wa 'l-`ajzi wa 'l-kasal, wa 'l-bukhli wa 'l-jubn, wa ḍala`id-dayni wa ghalabatir-rijāl.
en: O Allah! I seek refuge with You from worry and grief, from incapacity and laziness, from cowardice and miserliness, from being heavily in debt and from being overpowered by (other) men.

title: For beneficial knowledge, good provision and accepted deeds
ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ عِلْمًا نَافِعًا، وَرِزْقًا طَيِّبًا، وَعَمَلاً مُتَقَبَّلاً
tr: Allāhumma innī asʾaluka ʿilman nāfiʿan, wa rizqan ṭayyiban, wa ʿamalan mutaqabbalan.
en: O Allah, I ask You for beneficial knowledge, wholesome provision, and deeds that are accepted.
note: The Prophet ﷺ said this after the salam of the Fajr prayer.

title: When afraid of a group of people
ar: اللَّهُمَّ اكْفِنِيهِم بمَا شِئْت
tr: Allāhummak-finīhim bimā shi't
en: O Allah, suffice (i.e. protect) me against them however You wish.

title: Refuge in the perfect words of Allah
ref: Reported by Ahmad 2/290, An-Nasa'i, 'Amalul-Yawm wal-Laylah no. 590, At-Tirmidhi 3/187, Ibn As-Sunni no. 68.
ar: أَعـوذُ بِكَلِمـاتِ اللّهِ التّـامّـاتِ مِنْ شَـرِّ ما خَلَـق
tr: A`ūdhu bikalimāti-llāhit-tāmmāti min sharri mā khalaq
en: I seek refuge in the Perfect Words of Allah from the evil of what He has created.

title: Protecting children
ar: أَعِيذُكُمَا بِكَلِمَاتِ اللهِ التَّامَّةِ، مِنْ كُلِّ شَيْطَانٍ وَهَامَّةٍ، وَمِنْ كُلِّ عَيْنٍ لَامَّةٍ
tr: U`īthukumā bikalimāti 'llāhit-tāmmati min kulli shayṭānin wa hāmmah, wa min kulli `aynin lāmmah
en: I seek protection for you in the Perfect Words of Allah from every devil and every beast, and from every envious blameworthy eye.
note: The Prophet ﷺ used this for al-Hasan and al-Husayn. For one child say U`īdhuka (male) or U`īdhuki (female).

title: Upon committing a sin
ref: Abu Dawud 2/86, At-Tirmidhi 2/257. Al-Albani graded it authentic in Sahih Abu Dawud 1/283.
ar: مَا مِنْ عَبْدٍ يُذنِبُ ذَنْباً فَيُحْسِنُ الطُّهُورَ، ثُمَّ يَقُومُ فَيُصَلِّي رَكْعَتَيْنِ، ثُمَّ يَسْتَغْفِرُ اللَّهُ إِلاَّ غَفَرَ اللَّهُ لَهُ
tr: Mā min `abdin yudhnib dhanban fa-yuhsin al-ṭuhūr, thumma yaqūm fa-yusallī rak`atayn, thumma yastaghfir Allāh illā ghafar Allāh lahu
en: There is not any slave of Allah who commits a sin, then he perfects his purification and stands to pray two Rak'ahs of prayer, then seeks Allah's forgiveness, except that Allah will forgive him.
note: This is an action, not a fixed wording: purify, pray two rak'ahs, then seek forgiveness.

title: The Prophet's ﷺ own istighfar
ar: وَاللَّهِ إِنِّي لأَسْتَغفِرُ اللَّهَ وَأَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ فِي الْيَوْمِ أَكْثَرَ مِنْ سَبْعِينَ مَرَّةٍ
tr: Wa-llāhi innī la-astaghfiru-llāha wa-atūbu ilayhi fī-l-yawmi akthara min sab'īna marratan
en: By Allah, I seek the forgiveness of Allah, and repent to Him more than seventy times in a day.

title: When afflicted with doubt in faith
ref: Al-Hadid 57:3, Abu Dawud 4/329. Al-Albani graded it good in Sahih Abu Dawud, 3/962.
ar: هُوَ الأوَّلُ، وَالآخِـرُ، وَالظّـاهِـرُ، وَالْبـاطِـنُ، وَهُوَ بِكُلِّ شَيءٍ عَلـيم
tr: Huwa 'l-Awwalu wa 'l-Ākhir, waẓ-Ẓāhiru wal-Bāṭin, wa huwa bikulli shay'in `Alīm.
en: He is the First and the Last, the Most High and the Most Near. And He is the Knower of all things

title: For pain anywhere in the body
ar:
بِسْمِ اللَّهِ — ثَلاَثاً

أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ وَقُدْرَتِهِ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا أَجِدُ وَأُحَاذِرُ — سَبْعَ مَرَّاتٍ
tr: Bismillāh (3x). A'ūdhu billāhi wa qudratihi min sharri mā ajidu wa uḥādhir (7x)
en: With the Name of Allah (three times). Then say seven times: I seek refuge in Allah and in His Power from the evil of what I find and of what I guard against.
note: Place your hand on the place of pain. Some printed editions of Muslim read "a'ūdhu bi-'izzatillāhi wa qudratihi".

title: Ruqyah over the sick
ar: أَذْهِبِ الْبَاسَ رَبَّ النَّاسِ، اشْفِ وَأَنْتَ الشَّافِي لاَ شِفَاءَ إِلاَّ شِفَاؤُكَ، شِفَاءً لاَ يُغَادِرُ سَقَمًا
tr: Adhhibi ʾl-baʾsa Rabba ʾn-nās, ishfi wa anta ʾsh-Shāfī, lā shifāʾa illā shifāʾuk, shifāʾan lā yughādiru saqaman.
en: Take away the harm, O Lord of mankind. Heal, for You are the Healer. There is no healing but Your healing — a healing that leaves no illness behind.

title: Visiting the sick
ar: لا بأْسَ طَهـورٌ إِنْ شـاءَ الله
tr: Lā ba'sa ṭahūrun in shā Allāh
en: Do not worry, it will be a purification (for you), Allah willing.

title: Jibril's ruqyah on the Prophet ﷺ
ar: بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ مِنْ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ يُؤْذِيكَ مِنْ شَرِّ كُلِّ نَفْسٍ أَوْ عَيْنِ حَاسِدٍ اللَّهُ يَشْفِيكَ بِاسْمِ اللَّهِ أَرْقِيكَ
tr: Bismillāhi arqīk, min kulli shayʾin yuʾdhīk, min sharri kulli nafsin aw ʿaynin ḥāsid, Allāhu yashfīk, bismillāhi arqīk.
en: In the name of Allah I perform ruqyah for you, from everything that harms you, from the evil of every soul or envious eye. May Allah heal you. In the name of Allah I perform ruqyah for you.

title: When struck by a calamity
ar: إِنَّا لِلَّهِ وَإِنَّا إِلَيْهِ رَاجِعُونَ، اللَّهُمَّ أْجُرْنِي فِي مُصِيبَتِي، وَاخْلُفْ لِي خَيْراً مِنْهَا
tr: Innā lillāhi wa innā ilayhi rāji`ūn, Allāhumma-jurni fī muṣībatī wa 'khluf lī khayran minhā.
en: We are from Allah and unto Him we return. O Allah take me out of my plight and bring to me after it something better.
note: sunnah.com's Arabic for this entry contains a stray Latin character in إِنَا إِلَـyْهِ — corrected here to the standard text.

title: Placing the deceased in the grave
ref: Abu Dawud 3/314 with an authentic chain.
ar: بِسْـمِ اللهِ وَعَلـى سُـنَّةِ رَسـولِ الله
tr: Bismillāh wa `alā sunnati Rasūlillāh.
en: With the Name of Allah, and according to the Sunnah of the Messenger of Allah.

title: Istikharah — seeking guidance in a decision
ar: اللهم إني أستخيرك بعلمك، وأستقدرك بقدرتك، وأسألك من فضلك العظيم فإنك تقدِرُ ولا أقدِرُ، وتعلم ولا أعلم، وأنت علام الغيوب، اللهم إن كنت تعلم أن هذا الأمر خير لي في ديني ومعاشي وعاقبة أمري فاقدره لي ويسره لي، ثم بارك لي فيه، وإن كنت تعلم أن هذا الأمر شر لي في ديني ومعاشي وعاقبة أمري فاصرفه عني واصرفني عنه، واقدر لي الخير حيث كان، ثم ارضني به
tr: Allāhumma innī astakhīruka bi `ilmik, wa astaqdiruka biqudratik, wa as'aluka min faḍlika 'l-`Aẓīm, fa'innaka taqdiru wa lā aqdir, wa ta`lamu wa lā a`lam, wa anta `allāmu 'l-ghuyūb, Allāhumma in kunta ta`lamu anna hādha 'l-amra khayrun lī fī dīnī wa ma`āshī wa `āqibati amrī faqdurhu lī wa yassirhu lī thumma bārik lī fīh, wa in kunta ta`lamu anna hādha 'l-amra sharrun lī fī dīnī wa ma`āshī wa `āqibati 'amrī faṣrifhu `annī waṣrifnī `anh, waqdur liya 'l-khayra ḥaythu kān, thumma arḍinī bih.
en: O Allah, I seek the counsel of Your Knowledge, and I seek the help of Your Omnipotence, and I beseech You for Your Magnificent Grace. Surely, You are Capable and I am not. You know and I know not, and You are the Knower of the unseen. O Allah, if You know that this matter is good for me in my religion and in my life and for my welfare in the life to come, then ordain it for me and make it easy for me, then bless me in it. And if You know that this matter is bad for me in my religion and in my life and for my welfare in the life to come, then distance it from me, and distance me from it, and ordain for me what is good wherever it may be, and help me to be content with it.
note: Prayed as two rak'ahs of non-obligatory prayer, then this du'a, naming the matter at the marked point.

title: When waking up
ar: الحَمْـدُ لِلّهِ الّذي أَحْـيانا بَعْـدَ ما أَماتَـنا وَإليه النُّـشور
tr: Alḥamdu lillāhil-ladhī 'aḥyānā ba`da mā 'amātanā wa 'ilayhin-nushūr
en: Praise is to Allah Who gives us life after He has caused us to die and to Him is the return.

title: Before entering the bathroom
ar: بِسْمِ الله اللّهُـمَّ إِنِّـي أَعـوذُ بِـكَ مِـنَ الْخُـبْثِ وَالْخَبائِث
tr: Bismillāhi, Allāhumma 'innī 'a`ūdhu bika minal-khubthi walkhabā'ith.
en: In the Name of Allah. O Allah, I seek protection in You from evil and the evil ones (or, from the evil male and female Jinn).

title: When leaving the home
ref: Abu Dawud 4/325, At-Tirmidhi 5/490. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/151
ar: بِسْمِ اللهِ ، تَوَكَّلْـتُ عَلى اللهِ وَلا حَوْلَ وَلا قُـوَّةَ إِلاّ بِالله
tr: Bismillāhi, tawakkaltu `alallāhi, wa lā ḥawla wa lā quwwata illā billāh.
en: In the Name of Allah, I have placed my trust in Allah, there is no might and no power except by Allah.

title: Before eating
ref: At-Tirmidhi 5/506. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 3/158.
ar:
اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَأَطْعِمْنَا خَيْراً مِنْهُ

اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهِ وَزِدْنَا مِنْهُ
tr: Allāhumma bārik lanā fīhi wa aṭ`imnā khayran minh. [For milk:] Allāhumma bārik lanā fīhi wa zidnā minh
en: O Allah, bless us in it and provide us with better than it. [For milk:] O Allah, bless us in it and give us more of it.

title: When breaking the fast
ar: ذَهَبَ الظَّمَأُ وَابْتَلَّتِ الْعُرُوقُ وَثَبَتَ الأَجْرُ إِنْ شَاءَ اللَّهُ
tr: Dhahaba ʾẓ-ẓamaʾu wa-btallati ʾl-ʿurūqu wa thabata ʾl-ajru in shāʾa ʾllāh.
en: The thirst has gone, the veins are moistened, and the reward is certain, if Allah wills.
note: The widely printed "Allāhumma laka ṣumtu…" is Abu Dawud 2358 and is graded da'if by al-Albani.

title: Forgiveness while fasting
ref: Ibn Majah 1/557 from a supplication of Abdullah bin 'Amr. Al-Hafidh graded it as good.
ar: اللّهُـمَّ إِنَّـي أَسْـأَلُـكَ بِرَحْمَـتِكَ الّتي وَسِـعَت كُلَّ شيء، أَنْ تَغْـفِرَ لي
tr: Allāhumma innī as'aluka bi raḥmatika 'l-latī wasi`at kulla shay'an taghfira lī.
en: O Allah, I ask You by Your mercy, which encompasses all things, that You forgive me.

title: When setting out on a journey
ar: سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْأَلُكَ فِي سَفَرِنَا هَذَا الْبِرَّ وَالتَّقْوَى وَمِنَ الْعَمَلِ مَا تَرْضَى اللَّهُمَّ هَوِّنْ عَلَيْنَا سَفَرَنَا هَذَا وَاطْوِ عَنَّا بُعْدَهُ اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ الصَّاحِبُ فِي السَّفَرِ وَالْخَلِيفَةُ فِي الأَهْلِ
tr: Subḥāna ʾlladhī sakhkhara lanā hādhā wa mā kunnā lahu muqrinīn, wa innā ilā Rabbinā la-munqalibūn. Allāhumma innā nasʾaluka fī safarinā hādha ʾl-birra wa ʾt-taqwā, wa mina ʾl-ʿamali mā tarḍā. Allāhumma hawwin ʿalaynā safaranā hādhā wa-ṭwi ʿannā buʿdah. Allāhumma anta ʾṣ-ṣāḥibu fi ʾs-safar, wa ʾl-khalīfatu fi ʾl-ahl.
en: Glory to Him who has subjected this to us, for we could never have accomplished it ourselves, and to our Lord we shall surely return. O Allah, we ask You on this journey of ours for righteousness and piety, and for deeds that please You. O Allah, make this journey easy for us and fold up its distance. O Allah, You are the Companion on the journey and the Guardian over the family.

title: Opening the prayer (istiftah)
ref: Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah, An-Nasa'i, At-Tirmidhi. See Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 1/77.
ar: سُبْـحانَكَ اللّهُـمَّ وَبِحَمْـدِكَ وَتَبارَكَ اسْمُـكَ وَتَعـالى جَـدُّكَ وَلا إِلهَ غَيْرُك
tr: Subhānaka Allāhumma wa biḥamdika, wa tabāraka 'smuka, wa ta'ālā jadduka, wa lā 'ilāha ghayruk.
en: Glory is to You O Allah, and praise. Blessed is Your Name and Exalted is Your Majesty. There is none worthy of worship but You

title: While bowing (ruku)
ar: سُبْـحانَكَ اللّهُـمَّ رَبَّـنا وَبِحَـمْدِك، اللّهُـمَّ اغْفِـرْ لي
tr: Subḥānaka Allāhumma Rabbanā wa biḥamdika Allāhum-maghfir lī
en: Glory is to You, O Allah, our Lord, and praise is Yours. O Allah, forgive me.

title: Answering the adhan
ar: وَأَنا أَشْـهَدُ أَنْ لا إِلـهَ إِلاّ اللهُ وَحْـدَهُ لا شَـريكَ لَـه ، وَأَنَّ محَمّـداً عَبْـدُهُ وَرَسـولُه، رَضيـتُ بِاللهِ رَبَّاً ، وَبِمُحَمَّـدٍ رَسـولاً وَبِالإِسْلامِ دينَـاً
tr: Wa 'anā 'ash-hadu 'an lā 'ilāha 'illallāhu waḥdahu lā sharīka lahu wa 'anna Muḥammadan 'abduhu wa rasūluhu, raḍītu billāhi rabban, wa bi Muḥammadin rasūlan wa bi 'l-islāmi dīnan.
en: I bear witness that none has the right to be worshipped but Allah alone, Who has no partner, and that Muhammad is His slave and His Messenger. I am pleased with Allah as my Lord, with Muhammad as my Messenger and with Islam as my religion.
note: Said upon hearing the testimony of faith in the adhan.

title: Sayyid al-Istighfar
ar: اللَّهُمَّ أَنْتَ رَبِّي، لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ، خَلَقْتَنِي وَأَنَا عَبْدُكَ، وَأَنَا عَلَى عَهْدِكَ وَوَعْدِكَ مَا اسْتَطَعْتُ، أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ مَا صَنَعْتُ، أَبُوءُ لَكَ بِنِعْمَتِكَ عَلَىَّ وَأَبُوءُ لَكَ بِذَنْبِي، فَاغْفِرْ لِي، فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يَغْفِرُ الذُّنُوبَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ
tr: Allāhumma anta Rabbī, lā ilāha illā ant, khalaqtanī wa anā ʿabduk, wa anā ʿalā ʿahdika wa waʿdika mā ʾstaṭaʿt. Aʿūdhu bika min sharri mā ṣanaʿt. Abūʾu laka bi-niʿmatika ʿalayya, wa abūʾu laka bi-dhanbī, fa-ghfir lī fa-innahu lā yaghfiru ʾdh-dhunūba illā ant.
en: O Allah, You are my Lord; there is no god but You. You created me and I am Your servant, and I abide by Your covenant and promise as best I can. I seek refuge in You from the evil of what I have done. I acknowledge Your favour upon me and I acknowledge my sin, so forgive me; for none forgives sins but You.

title: Knower of the unseen — morning, evening and before sleep
ar: اللَّهُمَّ عَالِمَ الْغَيْبِ وَالشَّهَادَةِ فَاطِرَ السَّمَوَاتِ وَالأَرْضِ رَبَّ كُلِّ شَيْءٍ وَمَلِيكَهُ أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ أَنْتَ أَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّ نَفْسِي وَمِنْ شَرِّ الشَّيْطَانِ وَشِرْكِهِ
tr: Allāhumma ʿālima ʾl-ghaybi wa ʾsh-shahādah, fāṭira ʾs-samāwāti wa ʾl-arḍ, rabba kulli shayʾin wa malīkah, ash-hadu an lā ilāha illā ant, aʿūdhu bika min sharri nafsī wa min sharri ʾsh-shayṭāni wa shirkih.
en: O Allah, Knower of the unseen and the seen, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Lord and Sovereign of all things, I bear witness that there is no god but You. I seek refuge in You from the evil of my own soul and from the evil of Satan and his incitement to associate others with You.

title: To the newlywed
ref: Abu Dawud, Ibn Majah and At-Tirmidhi. See also Al-Albani, Sahih At-Tirmidhi 1/316.
ar: بارَكَ اللّهُ لَك، وَبارَكَ عَلَـيْك، وَجَمَعَ بَيْـنَكُما في خَـيْر
tr: Bārakallāhu lak, wa bāraka `alayk, wa jama`a baynakumā fī khayr.
en: May Allah bless you, and shower His blessings upon you, and join you together in goodness.
note: This is the reported greeting, in place of the pre-Islamic "bir-rafā'i wal-banīn".

title: On the wedding night
ref: Abu Dawud 2/248 and Ibn Majah 1/617. See also Al-Albani, Sahih Ibn Majah 1/324.
ar: اللَّهُمَّ إِنِّي أَسْأَلُكَ خَيْرَهَا، وَخَيْرَ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ، وَأَعُوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَرِّهَا، وَشَرِّ مَا جَبَلْتَهَا عَلَيْهِ
tr: Allāhumma innī as'aluka khayrahā wa khayra mā jabaltahā `alayh, wa a`ūdhu bika min sharrihā wa sharri mā jabaltahā `alayh.
en: O Allah, I ask You for the goodness of her, and the goodness upon which You have created her, and I seek refuge in You from the evil of her, and from the evil upon which You have created her.

title: Before intimacy
ar: بِسْمِ الله اللّهُـمَّ جَنِّبْنا الشَّيْـطانَ، وَجَنِّبِ الشَّـيْطانَ ما رَزَقْـتَنا
tr: Bismillāh. Allāhumma jannibnash-Shayṭān, wa jannibish-Shayṭāna mā razaqtanā.
en: With the Name of Allah. O Allah, keep the Devil away from us, and keep the Devil away from that which You provide for us.

title: During a wind storm
ref: Abu Dawud 4/326, Ibn Majah 2/1228. See also Al-Albani, Sahih Ibn Majah 2/305.
ar: اللّهُـمَّ إِنَّـي أَسْـأَلُـكَ خَيْـرَها، وَأَعـوذُ بِكَ مِنْ شَـرِّها
tr: Allāhumma innī as'aluka khayrahā, wa a`ūdhu bika min sharrihā.
en: O Allah, I ask You for the good of it, and seek refuge in You against its evil.

title: Upon hearing thunder
ref: Al-Muwatta' 2/992. Graded authentic by Al-Albani as a statement of Abdullah bin az-Zubayr only.
ar: سُبْـحانَ الّذي يُسَبِّـحُ الـرَّعْدُ بِحَمْـدِهِ، وَالملائِكـةُ مِنْ خيـفَته
tr: Subḥāna 'l-ladhī yusabbiḥur-ra`du bi ḥamdihi wa 'l-malā'ikatu min khīfatih.
en: Glory is to Him Whom thunder and angels glorify due to fear of Him.
note: This is the practice of Abdullah bin az-Zubayr, not a narration from the Prophet ﷺ. Label it as such.

title: Asking for rain
ref: Abu Dawud 1/303. See also Al-Albani Sahih Abu Dawud 1/216.
ar: اللّهُمَّ اسْقِـنا غَيْـثاً مُغيـثاً مَريئاً مُريـعاً، نافِعـاً غَيْـرَ ضار، عاجِـلاً غَـيْرَ آجِل
tr: Allāhumma 'asqinā ghaythan mughīthan marī'an murī`a, nāfi`an ghayra ḍārr, `ājilan ghayra ājil.
en: O Allah, shower upon us abundant rain, beneficial not harmful, swiftly and not delayed.

title: Asking for rain (2)
ref: Abu Dawud 1/305. Al-Albani graded it good in Sahih Abu Dawud 1/218.
ar: اللّهُمَّ اسْقِ عِبادَكَ وَبَهـائِمَك، وَانْشُـرْ رَحْمَـتَكَ وَأَحْيِي بَلَـدَكَ المَيِّـت
tr: Allāhumma'sqi `ibādaka wa bahā'imak, wanshur raḥmatak, wa aḥyi baladaka 'l-mayyit
en: O Allah, give water to Your slaves, and Your livestock, and spread Your mercy, and revive Your dead land.

title: When it rains
ar: اللّهُمَّ صَيِّـباً نافِـعاً
tr: Allāhumma ṣayyiban nāfi`a.
en: O Allah, (bring) beneficial rain clouds.

title: After rainfall
ar: مُطِـرْنا بِفَضْـلِ اللهِ وَرَحْمَـتِه
tr: Muṭirnā bifaḍlillāhi wa raḥmatih
en: We have been given rain by the grace and mercy of Allah.

title: The best act of Islam
ar: تُطْعِمُ الطَّعَامَ، وَتَقْرأُ السَّلاَمَ عَلَى مَنْ عَرَفْتَ وَمَنْ لَمْ تَعْرِفْ
tr: Tu'`im at-ta`am, wa-taqra'u as-salam `ala man `arafta wa-man lam ta`rif
en: To feed others and to give greetings of Salam (peace) to those whom you know and to those whom you do not know.

title: When angry
ar: أَعُوذُ بِاللَّهِ مِنَ الشَّيْطَانِ
tr: Aʿūdhu billāhi mina ʾsh-shayṭān.
en: I seek refuge with Allah from Satan.
note: The Prophet ﷺ said of a man visibly enraged: "I know a word which, if he said it, what he feels would leave him."

title: Jumu'ah — the hour when du'a is answered
ar: فِيهِ سَاعَةٌ لاَ يُوَافِقُهَا عَبْدٌ مُسْلِمٌ، وَهْوَ قَائِمٌ يُصَلِّي، يَسْأَلُ اللَّهَ تَعَالَى شَيْئًا إِلاَّ أَعْطَاهُ إِيَّاهُ
tr: Fīhi sāʿatun lā yuwāfiquhā ʿabdun muslim, wa huwa qāʾimun yuṣallī, yasʾalu ʾllāha taʿālā shayʾan illā aʿṭāhu iyyāh.
en: There is an hour (opportune time) on Friday and if a Muslim gets it while praying and asks something from Allah, then Allah will definitely meet his demand.
note: He indicated with his hand that it is brief. Widely held to be the last hour before Maghrib on Friday.

title: Jumu'ah — abundant salawat
ar: إِنَّ مِنْ أَفْضَلِ أَيَّامِكُمْ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ فِيهِ خُلِقَ آدَمُ وَفِيهِ قُبِضَ وَفِيهِ النَّفْخَةُ وَفِيهِ الصَّعْقَةُ فَأَكْثِرُوا عَلَىَّ مِنَ الصَّلاَةِ فِيهِ فَإِنَّ صَلاَتَكُمْ مَعْرُوضَةٌ عَلَىَّ
tr: Inna min afḍali ayyāmikum yawma ʾl-jumuʿah… fa-akthirū ʿalayya mina ʾṣ-ṣalāti fīh, fa-inna ṣalātakum maʿrūḍatun ʿalayy.
en: Among the most excellent of your days is Friday; on it Adam was created, on it he died, on it the last trumpet will be blown, and on it the shout will be made, so invoke more blessings on me that day, for your blessings will be submitted to me.

title: Jumu'ah — Surah al-Kahf
ar: مَنْ قَرَأَ سُورَةَ الْكَهْفِ فِي يَوْمِ الْجُمُعَةِ أَضَاءَ لَهُ النُّورُ مَا بَيْنَ الْجُمُعَتَيْنِ
tr: Man qaraʾa sūrata ʾl-Kahfi fī yawmi ʾl-jumuʿah, aḍāʾa lahu ʾn-nūru mā bayna ʾl-jumuʿatayn.
en: If anyone recites sūra al-Kahf on Friday, light will shine brightly for him till the next Friday.

title: Jumu'ah — ghusl and going early
ar: مَنِ اغْتَسَلَ يَوْمَ الْجُمُعَةِ غُسْلَ الْجَنَابَةِ ثُمَّ رَاحَ فَكَأَنَّمَا قَرَّبَ بَدَنَةً
tr: Mani-ghtasala yawma ʾl-jumuʿati ghusla ʾl-janābati thumma rāḥa fa-kaʾannamā qarraba badanah.
en: Any person who takes a bath on Friday like the bath of Janaba and then goes for the prayer (in the first hour i.e. early), it is as if he had sacrificed a camel.
note: The reward descends by hour — camel, then cow, then ram, then hen, then egg. When the imam comes out, the angels close their records and listen.
